description:
Outcome: Eligible unallocated applicants receive fair vacancy handling, from brief.md / First version 2 and Rules.
Scope: Atomically reconcile queue against ALL eligible unallocated applications before assignment; original application timestamp/sequence; coordinator records acceptance, decline and withdrawal. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Selective/delayed waitlisting cannot bypass earlier eligible applications; unresolved household declarations require reconciliation preserving original order before vacancy assignment; no returning-priority reordering within queue; released plot safely reassigned.
Behaviour: Reject stale actions; empty queue clear; consistent application/waitlist states; no automatic offer expiry. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Tests for delayed/out-of-order waitlisting, tie-breaks, release, accept/decline/withdrawal and retries. Prerequisites: T-006. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover.
title: Manage FIFO waiting list and vacancies
